profile.name: Elena Krayneva
profile.headline: Marketing & Business Analytics | Strategy
profile.subheadline: I combine professional experience in people analytics and process improvement with applied projects in marketing analytics, customer research, and market strategy. I turn data and research into clear recommendations, dashboards, and action plans.

experience.companyDescription: Digital division of X5 Group, Russia’s largest food retailer.
bullets: Analysed workforce data across 500+ employee records, including headcount, onboarding, attrition, and leave.
Built KPI-based reports, dashboards, and presentations for HR leadership and management decision-making.
Processed 150+ manager inputs for talent review and succession planning, improving data completeness and supporting insight generation.
Coordinated recurring reporting and data requests in collaboration with HRBP and cross-functional stakeholders.

experience.companyDescription: Russian audit and consulting firm, successor to PwC Russia.
bullets: Managed the full cycle of administration and documentation for 30+ external contractors each month.
Developed and maintained Excel trackers for contract approvals, renewals, payments, deadlines, and incoming requests.
Coordinated approval processes across HR, legal, finance, and business teams.
Supported calculations and payments by collecting data, validating accuracy, and monitoring deadlines.
Trained a colleague on HR processes and corporate systems and prepared supporting training materials.

experience.companyDescription: Global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures
bullets: Managed publication of job vacancies across internal and external platforms and coordinated initial candidate communication
Contributed to an external employer branding campaign through partnerships with universities and student outreach initiatives at both headquarters and regional offices
Supported recruitment pipeline tracking and prepared structured HR reports in Excel

experience.companyDescription: Health technology startup focusing on dermatological analytics
bullets: Structured and managed internal documentation workflows within a tech startup environment
